why: src/mcp-document-mutations.ts:277 resolves knowledge_base_name+path through kb-fs.ts resolveKbPath, which rejects absolute paths, '..' segments and null bytes, then realpath-checks every existing ancestor to confirm it stays inside the KB root before any write, and knowledge_base_name itself is confined to a single non-dotted, non-separator path.join child of the KB root via resolveKnowledgeBaseDir.

query/task_context only ever become LLM chat-completion prompt text (src/ask-core.ts buildAskMessages), model_name is validated against ^[a-z]+__[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ and the registered-model list in resolveActiveModel (src/active-model.ts), and llm_profile is looked up through llm-profiles.ts readProfile/profilePath, which calls assertProfileName (regex [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+) before building the on-disk profile path, so none of the caller-controlled fields reach a shell, path-traversal, or eval sink.

src/mcp-document-mutations.ts:386-407 resolves knowledge_base_name and path through the same resolveKnowledgeBaseDir + resolveKbPath guards as add_document (traversal/null-byte rejection plus realpath containment check) before fsp.rm is ever called, and the derived .index sidecar path is built from the already-validated relative path so it cannot itself escape the KB directory.

sink: manager.loadFromVersionDir(versionPath) -> loadFaissStoreFromVersionDir reads <versionPath>/faiss.index + docstore.json from anywhere on disk and the resulting metadata (source, relative_path, knowledge_base, chunk_id) is echoed back in the tool response
why: resolveIndexVersionPath (src/diff-index-core.ts:91-94) never runs the traversal/containment checks that kb-fs.ts applies to add_document/delete_document: an absolute `before`/`after` is returned untouched and a relative one is path.join'd onto modelDir with no rejection of '..' segments, so a caller can point diff_index at any directory on the host filesystem that happens to contain a faiss.index+docstore.json pair (e.g. a sibling model directory, a backup, or another tenant's index) and get back its document source paths, KB name and chunk identifiers via the similarity-search comparison. This is weakened to Tier B because the tool's own Zod schema/description explicitly documents 'BEFORE/AFTER index version number, relative directory, or absolute version directory' as an intended input shape (src/mcp-tool-specs.ts:122-123), so the absolute-path case is advertised behaviour rather than a pure oversight; the unrestricted relative-path traversal (no assertNoTraversal-style check at all, unlike every other path-handling helper in this repo) is the part that exceeds what a reasonable caller of a 'compare two persisted index versions' tool would expect, and I could not fully rule out that some real-world deployment host has such directories reachable from KB_INDEX_PATH.
contract: BEFORE index version number, relative directory, or absolute version directory.

why: src/kb-stats.ts:353-360 only accepts knowledge_base_name values that are already members of listKnowledgeBases()'s output (an exact-match check against the real KB directory names), throwing KB_NOT_FOUND otherwise, so the argument never reaches a filesystem path directly and there is no read-only-query surface for injection.
Takes no arguments; handleListKnowledgeBases just calls listKnowledgeBases(KNOWLEDGE_BASES_ROOT_DIR), a server-configured constant, and returns the directory listing.
Takes no arguments; handleListModels only reads the server's own registered-model registry and active-model pointer, with no caller-controlled input at all.

The optional knowledge_base_name is passed to resolveKnowledgeBaseDir (src/KnowledgeBaseServer.ts:855), which rejects dotted/absolute/separator-containing names and realpath-verifies containment under KNOWLEDGE_BASES_ROOT_DIR before any use; the tool's own description states the rebuild scope is always global regardless of this argument, so there is no path sink for it to reach, and the destructive full-rebuild behaviour is the tool's advertised purpose.

query is length-capped (KB_MAX_QUERY_CHARS) and only used as embedding/BM25 search input; path_glob is capped at 1024 chars and at most 64 wildcard characters before being handed to minimatch (src/mcp-tool-specs.ts:38-64), which is an explicit, deliberate ReDoS guard; knowledge_base_name is used purely as a metadata post-filter string inside FaissIndexManager.similaritySearch (src/FaissIndexManager.ts:2680-2789), never to build a filesystem path, so none of the caller-controlled fields reach an unguarded sink.
